newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Zuellig NZ appoints new managing director.
newsitem.headline: Zuellig NZ appoints new managing director.

text.p: Pharmaceutical manufacturer and distributor Zuellig New Zealand Ltd said on Thursday it had appointed Peter Wright to the position of managing director.
Wright, who joined the company in 1989, will be responsible for all operations of Zuellig NZ Ltd. The appointment is effective immediately.
In April Wright was appointed acting chief executive officer of Zuellig Pharma Ltd. That position will be filled by Peter Merton from September 1.
Zuellig said Wright had considerable experience in the pharmaceutical distribution business.
